Put the compiled ProDashPlugin.dll in THIS folder.

How to get it:
  - Open ..\..\plugin\SimHubProDash.sln in Visual Studio 2022
  - Build (Release). The build copies ProDashPlugin.dll here automatically
    (post-build step) AND into your SimHub folder.
  - Or copy it from your SimHub install folder after a successful build.

The installer (Install ProDash.bat) copies this DLL into SimHub for you.
If the DLL is absent, the installer still installs the dashboards and just
skips the plugin copy.
